_principle: A key proves signature authenticity only; it does not confer authority. Authority comes from the pre-existing effective mandate bound below. The public key authenticates the mandate; it cannot create the mandate that authorizes itself.
_boundary: The PRIVATE key is generated and held solely by the operator, offline; never in this repository; no agent handles it.
